objective: Cut the median lot review from 11 to 4 minutes without releasing a single out-of-spec lot.
value_proposition: Reviewers see every certificate result against its limit, with a derived and explained verdict, and decide on one screen.

in_scope: Lot review: comparison, verdict, guarded decision with rationale
Loading, empty, error and not-found states
non_goals: Auto-releasing lots without a human decision
Replacing the QA lead's judgement on escalations

success_criteria.name: Median review time per lot
success_criteria.method: Timed moderated sessions, 5 reviewers per round

success_criteria.name: Out-of-spec values caught on first review
success_criteria.method: Seeded out-of-spec lots in the session set

success_criteria.name: Wrong releases
success_criteria.method: Every release checked against the specification in the session log

success_criteria.name: Reviewers who try to bypass the release guard

rollback_triggers: If fewer than 4 of 5 reviewers complete S-01 unaided in round one, stop and revisit the comparison layout
If any session releases an out-of-spec lot, stop the pilot and fix the guard before round two

open_questions.question: Can the plant's LIMS export certificate values as structured data?
open_questions.trigger: The LIMS owner confirms the export format
